notablePrerequisites:
Ensoul Artifact attached to Prototype Portal.
Prototype Portal does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Prototype Portal by tapping it, creating a token copy of Treasure Vault.
When the Treasure Vault token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure Vault tokens, you may tap them for infinite mana, and then use a Treasure Vault to create infinite Treasure toknes.
